clauses.quote: Good faith efforts shall be made to maintain class sizes, which recognize the needs and requests of students, as well as the interests of the teachers and the schools.
Reasonable efforts shall be made to balance class sizes for summer school and intersession by the beginning of the second week of classes.
The selection process shall emphasize selection of teachers with recent training and/or recent experience in the teaching of reading.
At grade levels fourth (4th) through eighth (8th) recent experience in reading, language arts, and math shall be emphasized.
clauses.subject_text: recent experience in reading, language arts, and math

clauses.quote: If two or more applicants have equal qualifications within a 16.7.1 priority, seniority in the District shall be the determining factor.
Prior assignments in these programs will decrease priority selection after two (2) consecutive years of service in these programs.
clauses.notes: Sets an automatic rule for priority reduction in program selection.

clauses.quote: Teachers volunteering to teach in the programs shall be paid $25.00 per hour of instruction.
clauses.subject_text: Teachers volunteering to teach in the programs
